title: Serene & Modern House in an Authentic Neighborhood
description:
Create meals in a fully equipped kitchen with plenty of prep space. Then kick back and relax in a detached house that's been decorated with a designer's flair. At night, crawl under comfy sheets and curl up with a movie on TV.

STRP #2018047675

My home is located very close to Downtown,  just a few miles away and a quick uber ride.

The space
Main level open floor plan with living dining and kitchen combo provides room for your group to gather without feeling crowded.  A full bath is located off the hallway with a private connection to the bedroom on the first floor.  This bedroom has a twin size daybed. With trundle and a smart tv. There is also a queen size sofa bed in the living area.  The second level has three bedrooms and two full baths, separated by a long, light filled hallway. The primary retreat is located at the end of the long hallway and is fitted with a king size bed, smart tv, and en-suite bath with walk-in shower, double vanities, and a private water closet. There is another bedroom with king bed and smart tv on this level and a fourth bedroom with a king bed.  These rooms share a hall full bath.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home except the owners storage room on the first level and one closet upstairs.
